  <h1 id="hs_cos_wrapper_kb-article-module-3_" class="hs_cos_wrapper hs_cos_wrapper_widget hs_cos_wrapper_type_inline_text_field" style="" data-hs-cos-general-type="widget" data-hs-cos-type="inline_text_field">Distributing to Amazon with PublishDrive</h1>
</div>

</div><!--end widget-span -->

</div><!--end row-wrapper -->

<div class="row-fluid-wrapper row-depth-1 row-number-4 dnd-row">
<div class="row-fluid ">

<div id="hs_cos_wrapper_kb-article-module-4" class="hs_cos_wrapper hs_cos_wrapper_widget hs_cos_wrapper_type_module" style="" data-hs-cos-general-type="widget" data-hs-cos-type="module">
  <h2 id="hs_cos_wrapper_kb-article-module-4_" class="hs_cos_wrapper hs_cos_wrapper_widget hs_cos_wrapper_type_inline_text_field" style="" data-hs-cos-general-type="widget" data-hs-cos-type="inline_text_field">Amazon is one of the largest global marketplaces for both ebooks and print-on-demand titles. Through PublishDrive, you can easily distribute your books to Amazon and reach a wide international audience.</h2>
</div>

</div><!--end widget-span -->
</div><!--end row-->
</div><!--end row-wrapper -->

<div class="row-fluid-wrapper row-depth-1 row-number-5 dnd-row">
<div class="row-fluid ">
<div class="span12 widget-span widget-type-custom_widget dnd-module" style="" data-widget-type="custom_widget" data-x="0" data-w="12">
<div id="hs_cos_wrapper_kb-article-module-5" class="hs_cos_wrapper hs_cos_wrapper_widget hs_cos_wrapper_type_module" style="" data-hs-cos-general-type="widget" data-hs-cos-type="module">
  <div id="hs_cos_wrapper_kb-article-module-5_" class="hs_cos_wrapper hs_cos_wrapper_widget hs_cos_wrapper_type_inline_richtext_field" style="" data-hs-cos-general-type="widget" data-hs-cos-type="inline_richtext_field"><p><img class="hs-image-align-center" height="175" style="height: auto; width: 395px;" src="https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Apr-16-2025-09-39-25-3844-AM.png?width=395&height=175&name=image-png-Apr-16-2025-09-39-25-3844-AM.png" width="395" loading="lazy" srcset="https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Apr-16-2025-09-39-25-3844-AM.png?width=198&height=88&name=image-png-Apr-16-2025-09-39-25-3844-AM.png 198w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Apr-16-2025-09-39-25-3844-AM.png?width=395&height=175&name=image-png-Apr-16-2025-09-39-25-3844-AM.png 395w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Apr-16-2025-09-39-25-3844-AM.png?width=593&height=263&name=image-png-Apr-16-2025-09-39-25-3844-AM.png 593w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Apr-16-2025-09-39-25-3844-AM.png?width=790&height=350&name=image-png-Apr-16-2025-09-39-25-3844-AM.png 790w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Apr-16-2025-09-39-25-3844-AM.png?width=988&height=438&name=image-png-Apr-16-2025-09-39-25-3844-AM.png 988w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Apr-16-2025-09-39-25-3844-AM.png?width=1185&height=525&name=image-png-Apr-16-2025-09-39-25-3844-AM.png 1185w" sizes="(max-width: 395px) 100vw, 395px"></p>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>📝 Formats</strong></p>
<p> </p>
<p>PublishDrive supports two formats for Amazon:</p>
<p>•<strong>Ebook</strong></p>
<p>•<strong>Print-on-Demand (POD)</strong></p>
<p> </p>
<p>You can choose either or both formats when publishing your title.</p>
<p> </p>
<hr>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>⏱ Publishing Time</strong></p>
<p> </p>
<p>Books are typically published on Amazon within <strong>1–3 business days</strong> after submission via PublishDrive.</p>
<p> </p>
<hr>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>💸 Distribution Model</strong></p>
<p> </p>
<p>Amazon works with a <strong>wholesale model</strong>, meaning Amazon has the right to adjust the final retail price based on the list price you set.</p>
<p> </p>
<hr>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>📈 Royalty Rates</strong></p>
<p>•<strong>Ebook</strong>: 60% royalty</p>
<p>•<strong>Print-on-Demand</strong>: 50% royalty</p>
<p> </p>
<p>Royalties are calculated from the list price, minus taxes and distribution fees.</p>
<p> </p>
<hr>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>🔖 ISBN Requirements</strong></p>
<p>•<strong>Print titles</strong>: An <strong>ISBN is required</strong>. </p>
<p>•<strong>Ebook titles</strong>: <strong>No ISBN is required</strong>.</p>
<p> </p>
<hr>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>✅ Content Policy</strong></p>
<p> </p>
<p>✔️ <strong>Adult content is accepted</strong></p>
<p>❌ <strong>Public domain content is not accepted</strong></p>
<p> </p>
<p>All content must comply with Amazon’s publishing and quality guidelines.</p>
<p> </p>
<hr>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>🌍 Accepted Languages</strong></p>
<p> </p>
<p>Amazon accepts titles in the following languages via PublishDrive:</p>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>EN-GB, EN, ES, DE, FR, PT, IT, HI, ZH-HANT, SCO, PRO, FRR, ML, FRS, GSW, TA, MR, GU, AR, SV, RM, NO, NB, NN, NL, LB, JA, IS, GV, GL, GA, GD, FY, FI, EU, DA, CY, CO, KW, CA, BR, AF</strong></p>
<p> </p>
<hr>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>📌 Territory Focus</strong></p>
<p> </p>
<p>Amazon has <strong>global coverage</strong>. You can choose to distribute worldwide or target specific countries.</p>
<p> </p>
<hr>
<p> </p>
<p>If you have any questions about distributing your title to Amazon, feel free to contact our support team.</p></div>

  <h2 id="hs_cos_wrapper_kb-article-module-4_" class="hs_cos_wrapper hs_cos_wrapper_widget hs_cos_wrapper_type_inline_text_field" style="" data-hs-cos-general-type="widget" data-hs-cos-type="inline_text_field">Learn how to upload, format, and publish your ebook on PublishDrive, from file preparation to store distribution.</h2>

<div id="hs_cos_wrapper_kb-article-module-5" class="hs_cos_wrapper hs_cos_wrapper_widget hs_cos_wrapper_type_module" style="" data-hs-cos-general-type="widget" data-hs-cos-type="module">
  <div id="hs_cos_wrapper_kb-article-module-5_" class="hs_cos_wrapper hs_cos_wrapper_widget hs_cos_wrapper_type_inline_richtext_field" style="" data-hs-cos-general-type="widget" data-hs-cos-type="inline_richtext_field"><div>
<h4 style="text-align: justify;"><strong>1. Prepare Your Materials 📝</strong></h4>
<p style="text-align: justify;">Before you start, ensure you have your metadata, content file, and cover file ready. These essential components will shape your book's presence.</p>
<h4 style="text-align: justify;"><strong>2. Access 'My Books' 📚</strong></h4>
<p style="text-align: justify;">Upon logging into your PublishDrive account, navigate to the 'My Books' section via the main dashboard. Look for the '<strong>Book Upload</strong>' button within the 'My Books' menu.</p>
<p style="text-align: justify;"><img class="hs-image-align-none" height="509" style="height: auto; width: 688px;" src="https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-02-39-4483-PM.png?width=688&height=509&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-02-39-4483-PM.png" width="688" srcset="https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-02-39-4483-PM.png?width=344&height=255&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-02-39-4483-PM.png 344w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-02-39-4483-PM.png?width=688&height=509&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-02-39-4483-PM.png 688w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-02-39-4483-PM.png?width=1032&height=764&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-02-39-4483-PM.png 1032w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-02-39-4483-PM.png?width=1376&height=1018&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-02-39-4483-PM.png 1376w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-02-39-4483-PM.png?width=1720&height=1273&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-02-39-4483-PM.png 1720w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-02-39-4483-PM.png?width=2064&height=1527&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-02-39-4483-PM.png 2064w" sizes="(max-width: 688px) 100vw, 688px"></p>
<h4 style="text-align: justify;"><strong>3. </strong><strong>Choose Your Format 🎭</strong></h4>
<p>Select the format that matches your book: in this case, it will be an <strong>ebook</strong>.</p>
<p>For a print book's specific requirements, explore this <a href="//139818115.hs-sites-eu1.com/help-center/how-to-upload-a-print-on-demand-book-1?hsLang=en" rel="noopener">detailed article</a>.</p>
<p>If you're diving into audiobook uploading, consult this <a href="https://139818115.hs-sites-eu1.com/help-center/how-to-upload-an-audiobook?hsLang=en" rel="noopener">comprehensive guide.</a></p>
<p> </p>
<p style="text-align: justify;"><img class="hs-image-align-none" height="503" style="height: auto; width: 682px;" src="https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-03-34-1720-PM.png?width=682&height=503&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-03-34-1720-PM.png" width="682" loading="lazy" srcset="https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-03-34-1720-PM.png?width=341&height=252&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-03-34-1720-PM.png 341w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-03-34-1720-PM.png?width=682&height=503&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-03-34-1720-PM.png 682w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-03-34-1720-PM.png?width=1023&height=755&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-03-34-1720-PM.png 1023w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-03-34-1720-PM.png?width=1364&height=1006&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-03-34-1720-PM.png 1364w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-03-34-1720-PM.png?width=1705&height=1258&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-03-34-1720-PM.png 1705w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-03-34-1720-PM.png?width=2046&height=1509&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-03-34-1720-PM.png 2046w" sizes="(max-width: 682px) 100vw, 682px"></p>
<h4 style="text-align: justify;"><strong>4. </strong><strong>Step-by-Step Upload ⬆️</strong></h4>
<p>Upon reaching this page, you'll encounter the new book interface where you can seamlessly upload your book and input metadata. If you wish to make modifications in the future, simply choose the title you wish to edit, and this form will promptly appear again.</p>
<p>The following stages are the key steps of the upload process:</p>
<p style="text-align: justify;"><img class="hs-image-align-none" height="564" style="height: auto; width: 688px;" src="https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-17-24-1754-PM.png?width=688&height=564&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-17-24-1754-PM.png" width="688" loading="lazy" srcset="https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-17-24-1754-PM.png?width=344&height=282&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-17-24-1754-PM.png 344w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-17-24-1754-PM.png?width=688&height=564&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-17-24-1754-PM.png 688w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-17-24-1754-PM.png?width=1032&height=846&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-17-24-1754-PM.png 1032w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-17-24-1754-PM.png?width=1376&height=1128&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-17-24-1754-PM.png 1376w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-17-24-1754-PM.png?width=1720&height=1410&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-17-24-1754-PM.png 1720w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-17-24-1754-PM.png?width=2064&height=1692&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-17-24-1754-PM.png 2064w" sizes="(max-width: 688px) 100vw, 688px"></p>
<p style="text-align: justify;"> </p>
<p style="text-align: justify;"><strong>📂 Files</strong></p>
<p style="text-align: justify;">Simply drag and drop your content file (EPUB) and cover file (jpg) into the designated fields. Note that we accept both EPUB 2 and EPUB 3 formats, along with docx for EPUB conversion. Upon your initial upload, our automated system will scan your book and provide correction suggestions. <br><strong>⚠️Error detection</strong>: If any errors are detected during the initial review, a notification will appear in red, providing you with guidance on how to address the issues.</p>
<h4 style="text-align: justify;"><img class="hs-image-align-none" height="594" style="height: auto; width: 671px;" src="https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-22-22-6511-PM.png?width=671&height=594&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-22-22-6511-PM.png" width="671" loading="lazy" srcset="https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-22-22-6511-PM.png?width=336&height=297&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-22-22-6511-PM.png 336w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-22-22-6511-PM.png?width=671&height=594&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-22-22-6511-PM.png 671w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-22-22-6511-PM.png?width=1007&height=891&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-22-22-6511-PM.png 1007w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-22-22-6511-PM.png?width=1342&height=1188&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-22-22-6511-PM.png 1342w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-22-22-6511-PM.png?width=1678&height=1485&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-22-22-6511-PM.png 1678w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-22-22-6511-PM.png?width=2013&height=1782&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-22-22-6511-PM.png 2013w" sizes="(max-width: 671px) 100vw, 671px"></h4>
<p style="text-align: justify;">After adding your EPUB file, we analyze its embedded metadata and seamlessly populate corresponding fields. You have the option to either <strong>accept </strong>or <strong>decline </strong>the auto-filled metadata we've extracted. Opting out of the auto-fill is as simple as refraining from clicking the "Import selected fields" button, prompting you to input your metadata manually.</p>
<p style="text-align: justify;"><img class="hs-image-align-none" height="588" style="height: auto; width: 688px;" src="https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-25-36-9803-PM.png?width=688&height=588&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-25-36-9803-PM.png" width="688" loading="lazy" srcset="https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-25-36-9803-PM.png?width=344&height=294&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-25-36-9803-PM.png 344w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-25-36-9803-PM.png?width=688&height=588&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-25-36-9803-PM.png 688w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-25-36-9803-PM.png?width=1032&height=882&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-25-36-9803-PM.png 1032w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-25-36-9803-PM.png?width=1376&height=1176&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-25-36-9803-PM.png 1376w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-25-36-9803-PM.png?width=1720&height=1470&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-25-36-9803-PM.png 1720w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-25-36-9803-PM.png?width=2064&height=1764&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-25-36-9803-PM.png 2064w" sizes="(max-width: 688px) 100vw, 688px"></p>
<p style="text-align: justify;"><strong>If you don't have an EPUB file</strong>, select "other files" and drag and drop your Word document (.docx) into the designated "Source files" field. Alternatively, you have the option to drop it directly into the Content file field.</p>
<p style="text-align: justify;"><img class="hs-image-align-none" height="470" style="height: auto; width: 688px;" src="https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-30-56-5403-PM.png?width=688&height=470&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-30-56-5403-PM.png" width="688" loading="lazy" srcset="https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-30-56-5403-PM.png?width=344&height=235&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-30-56-5403-PM.png 344w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-30-56-5403-PM.png?width=688&height=470&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-30-56-5403-PM.png 688w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-30-56-5403-PM.png?width=1032&height=705&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-30-56-5403-PM.png 1032w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-30-56-5403-PM.png?width=1376&height=940&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-30-56-5403-PM.png 1376w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-30-56-5403-PM.png?width=1720&height=1175&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-30-56-5403-PM.png 1720w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-30-56-5403-PM.png?width=2064&height=1410&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-30-56-5403-PM.png 2064w" sizes="(max-width: 688px) 100vw, 688px"></p>
<p style="text-align: justify;">In this case, you'll be prompted to answer four questions concerning your book's content and structure, with the conversion options conveniently situated at the bottom of the page.</p>
<h3 style="text-align: justify;"><strong>Creators ✍️</strong></h3>
<p>This is the field for the book's contributors: author, editor, illustrator, or translator.</p>
<p> </p>
<p style="text-align: justify;"><img class="hs-image-align-none" height="336" style="height: auto; width: 688px;" src="https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-41-15-0702-PM.png?width=688&height=336&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-41-15-0702-PM.png" width="688" loading="lazy" srcset="https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-41-15-0702-PM.png?width=344&height=168&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-41-15-0702-PM.png 344w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-41-15-0702-PM.png?width=688&height=336&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-41-15-0702-PM.png 688w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-41-15-0702-PM.png?width=1032&height=504&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-41-15-0702-PM.png 1032w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-41-15-0702-PM.png?width=1376&height=672&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-41-15-0702-PM.png 1376w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-41-15-0702-PM.png?width=1720&height=840&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-41-15-0702-PM.png 1720w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-41-15-0702-PM.png?width=2064&height=1008&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-41-15-0702-PM.png 2064w" sizes="(max-width: 688px) 100vw, 688px"></p>
<p style="text-align: justify;">You can use your pen name in the contributor field, but please don’t use pen names that could be misleading to readers. <strong>The author's name on the cover should match the name you enter here</strong>, and <strong>all authors mentioned on the cover need to be listed in the metadata</strong>. If there is no author, you can select an editor instead.</p>
<p style="text-align: justify;"><img class="hs-image-align-none" height="383" style="height: auto; width: 688px;" src="https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-42-22-7289-PM.png?width=688&height=383&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-42-22-7289-PM.png" width="688" loading="lazy" srcset="https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-42-22-7289-PM.png?width=344&height=192&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-42-22-7289-PM.png 344w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-42-22-7289-PM.png?width=688&height=383&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-42-22-7289-PM.png 688w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-42-22-7289-PM.png?width=1032&height=575&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-42-22-7289-PM.png 1032w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-42-22-7289-PM.png?width=1376&height=766&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-42-22-7289-PM.png 1376w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-42-22-7289-PM.png?width=1720&height=958&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-42-22-7289-PM.png 1720w, https://help.publishdrive.com/hs-fs/hubfs/image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-42-22-7289-PM.png?width=2064&height=1149&name=image-png-Feb-05-2025-08-42-22-7289-PM.png 2064w" sizes="(max-width: 688px) 100vw, 688px"></p>
<p style="text-align: justify;">*If your book has AI, please remember to mention it as Author/Editor.</p>
<h3 style="text-align: justify;"><strong>Metadata 🔍</strong></h3>
<p style="text-align: justify;">Help your book stand out and be easier to find through metadata customization.</p>

Distribution API

PublishDrive public Distribution API — production and staging base URLs, publish and manage books programmatically across global stores and libraries.

Production base URL: https://api.publishdrive.com/v2/distribution. Staging (sandbox): https://api.sandbox.dev.publishdrive.com/v2/distribution. On each API operation page, use the server selector so generated examples and the playground use the environment you want. Send your API key in the apikey header on every request.

Endpoint reference is under API in the sidebar.

PublishDrive

Self-Publishing Platform for Global Book Distribution

Self-publishing made simple with tools for every step of your journey. Publish ebooks, print, and audiobooks, and reach readers worldwide through 50+ stores and 240,000+ libraries, including Amazon, Apple Books, Google Play, Kobo, and more — the widest distribution network in the industry.

This API is part of that platform: you integrate your systems with PublishDrive to create and update titles, move files through our upload pipeline, and control publication to the channels you enable for your account.

How publishing works with the API

Every book follows the same five-step pattern: authenticate, create the book record, upload and register files, then publish when you are ready.

Authenticate every call

Request an API key from PublishDrive support and send it on each request as the apikey header against the distribution base URL for the environment you use (production or staging).

Create the book record

Call Create Book with metadata (title, contributors, formats, pricing, territories, and other fields required for your edition). The response gives you a book identifier to use in later steps.

Request upload URLs and upload your files

For each manuscript, cover, audio asset, or other binary, call Request upload URLs. The response contains a presigned URL and a fileId for each file. Upload the bytes with HTTP PUT to the presigned URL before it expires.

Complete each upload and attach the file to the book

After PUT-ing the bytes to the presigned URL, call Attach file to confirm the transfer, trigger processing, and link the file to the book. This call is required for every file — the book will not reference the asset until it succeeds.

Publish or update distribution

When metadata and files are valid for your channels, call Publish book to send the title to stores and libraries. Use Update book for changes, Unpublish book to pull from distribution, and Get book (or Get book by external id) to read current state. List books helps you sync your catalog.

For request and response shapes, open the operation pages under API; they are generated from the same OpenAPI contract as the live service.

Audiobooks: file uploads and chapters

Use the same upload flow as for other formats: call Request upload URLs for each audio asset (role audio_content) and the cover (role audio_cover), PUT the bytes to the presigned URLs, then Attach file for every file. Save the fileId returned by each upload — you will need it when defining chapters.

Chapters are not created by the upload or attach calls alone. After each audio content file is registered for the book, run Update book and send a chapters array. Each item ties one content file to a chapter:

  • sequence — chapter order; this is the upsert key (if no chapter exists for that sequence it is created; if it exists it is updated).
  • fileId — UUID of the attached audio content file for that chapter (required when defining or changing which file backs the chapter).
  • title — required when creating a new chapter row.
  • titleAscii — use when the title contains characters outside ASCII (see the schema on Update book).

Each audio content file should belong to exactly one chapter; assign every chapter a content file through this mechanism.

Print on demand (POD)

Print titles use the same upload pipeline with file roles pod_content (interior) and pod_cover (cover). See Example: Print on demand upload for a focused walkthrough after you create the book with format: "print" and a valid ISBN.

Example: List books

Paginate and filter your catalog with the List books endpoint — page, perPage, format, language, and sort.

PublishDrive Pricing FAQs

Does PublishDrive take a commission from royalties?

PublishDrive uses a subscription-based pricing model, which allows authors and publishers to keep 100% of their royalties on eligible paid plans.

Can I publish a book for free with PublishDrive?

Yes. PublishDrive allows users to publish one ebook for free to selected stores, including Apple Books, Barnes & Noble, and Kobo.

Which PublishDrive plan should I choose?

The best plan depends on your catalog size, publishing formats, and distribution needs. New authors may start with the free option, while authors with more titles or publishers with larger catalogs may benefit from a paid or custom plan.

Does PublishDrive offer custom pricing?

Yes. PublishDrive offers custom plans for users with larger catalogs, high title volumes, or more advanced publishing needs.

Is Abacus included in PublishDrive pricing?

Abacus royalty management has separate pricing, with custom pricing available for users who manage multiple titles or larger royalty reporting workflows.

Does PublishDrive pricing include AI publishing tools?

Publishing Assistant credits are priced separately and can be used for AI-assisted metadata generation, category suggestions, descriptions, keywords, and cover image creation.
